label: PF Backlog 538
title: C6: Tool/Action Security Gateway + Tool-Result Guardrail (policy+risk+approval+sandbox per action; injection-scan results)
body:
## Problem / why
We have a tool allow-list, not a per-action authorization gateway; tool RESULTS are not scanned for injection.
## Acceptance criteria
Every agent tool invocation passes policy->risk->approval->sandbox; tool results are content-classified + injection-scanned + trust-labelled before re-entering agent context (e.g. GitHub issue text is untrusted data).
